courses.summary: CLOV 是安哥拉的多油田整合浮式開發；課程把不同來液條件接到同一處理中心的假想負荷帳。本課依序分析多油田品質混合、不同來液停留時間、液體輸送能耗比較、共用中心停機影響、來源分配與總量閉合，每項都包含可重算模型、證據規劃、故障辨析與驗收成果。數字全部是教學假設；不宣稱本案例採用這些設備參數。
courses.summaryEn: CLOV is an Angolan multi-field floating development; teaching combines different feed conditions into one hypothetical hub account. The course analyses quality blending across fields, residence for different feed streams, comparing liquid-transfer energy, outage effects of a shared hub, allocation and total-balance closure, with recalculable models, evidence plans, fault discrimination and acceptance artifacts. All numbers are teaching assumptions; no plant-specific parameter is asserted.
